name: Ezer
overview: The name Ezer appears in Scripture referring to several distinct individuals, including a Horite duke among the chiefs of Seir, a son of Ephraim, and a Levite connected with the worship in Jerusalem. The Horite duke Ezer is noted alongside Dishon and Dishan as leaders in Edom, emphasizing his role in ancient tribal governance. Additionally, a Levite named Ezer is mentioned among the singers who served under Jezrahiah during temple worship, highlighting a priestly or Levitical function. These references collectively illustrate Ezer as a name associated with leadership, both secular and sacred, within the biblical narrative.
